text.card: A red giant 2,883 parsecs away, 20 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 11, give 1.41 solar masses and 19.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,292 K at its surface.
